Since Warframe launched 13 years ago, the PvE, third-person looter-shooter has been confined to the Origin solar system—an in-game representation of the real-world solar system Earth is part of—but the game's next update, named Tau, changes that. The Tau update , now officially confirmed to be launching on December 9 on PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Android, Switch, and iOS, introduces a whole new solar system for players to explore, starting with the ring city of Fornax and the war-torn moon, Perita.
Digital Extremes explained that the Tau system will start with two playable areas, but the game studio plans on "building a new solar system brick-by-brick," adding that "alone, by now, this would have been Warframe two," because of the expansive scope of the new system. Tau will apparently approach things differently than other Warframe hub areas. Players will initially start the journey into Tau with a story mission on the order of two hours long, after which they will be able to explore Fornax and the World-Seeder Oasis.
